headline: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Reports Revenue Growth in First Nine Months of 2026
summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics reported revenue growth for the first nine months of 2026. An October agreement expanded its U.S. customer program to approximately $5.1 million in committed base services.
why: Scinai is a biopharmaceutical company providing contract development and manufacturing services. Revenue growth in its CDMO business is a key indicator of operational success and client demand.
